description: Rebuilds the imported kernel constant map, shadows Init oleans, and tests native reduceBool divergence during comparator replay.

witness.solution:
import Mathlib
import Lean

open Lean
open Lean.Meta
open System

run_elab
  let originalEnv ← getEnv
  let findPrivate (userName : Name) : Option Name :=
    originalEnv.constants.toList.findSome? (fun (n, _) =>
      if privateToUserName n == userName then some n else none)

  let some setCheckedName := findPrivate `Lean.Environment.setCheckedSync
    | throwError "private declaration not found: Lean.Environment.setCheckedSync"
  let some kernelMkName := findPrivate `Lean.Kernel.Environment.mk
    | throwError "private declaration not found: Lean.Kernel.Environment.mk"
  let some extensionsName := findPrivate `Lean.Kernel.Environment.extensions
    | throwError "private declaration not found: Lean.Kernel.Environment.extensions"

  let setCheckedInfo ← getConstInfo setCheckedName
  let kernelMkInfo ← getConstInfo kernelMkName
  let extensionsInfo ← getConstInfo extensionsName
  let setChecked ← Meta.evalExpr (Environment → Lean.Kernel.Environment → Environment)
    setCheckedInfo.type (mkConst setCheckedName)
  let kernelMk ← Meta.evalExpr
    (ConstMap → Bool → Lean.Kernel.Diagnostics → Std.HashMap Name ModuleIdx →
      Array EnvExtensionState → Array EnvExtensionState → EnvironmentHeader →
      Lean.Kernel.Environment)
    kernelMkInfo.type (mkConst kernelMkName)
  let getExtensions ← Meta.evalExpr
    (Lean.Kernel.Environment → Array EnvExtensionState)
    extensionsInfo.type (mkConst extensionsName)

  let boolTy := mkConst ``Bool
  let reduceBoolType := mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy boolTy
  let reduceBoolValue := mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy (mkBVar 0)
  let reduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `Lean.reduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := reduceBoolType
      value := reduceBoolValue
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`Lean.reduceBool]
    }

  let eqConst := mkConst ``Eq [1]
  let eqBool (lhs rhs : Expr) := mkApp3 eqConst boolTy lhs rhs
  let rbConst := mkConst `Lean.reduceBool
  let hType := eqBool (mkApp rbConst (mkBVar 1)) (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolType :=
    mkForall `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkForall `h BinderInfo.default hType <|
          eqBool (mkBVar 2) (mkBVar 1)
  let ofReduceBoolValue :=
    mkLambda `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkLambda `h BinderInfo.default hType (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .thmInfo {
      name := `Lean.ofReduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := ofReduceBoolType
      value := ofReduceBoolValue
      all := [`Lean.ofReduceBool]
    }

  let platformInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `System.Platform.isEmscripten
      levelParams := []
      type := boolTy
      value := mkConst ``Bool.true
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`System.Platform.isEmscripten]
    }

  let map1 := originalEnv.constants.map₁.insert `Lean.reduceBool reduceBoolInfo
  let map1 := map1.insert `Lean.ofReduceBool ofReduceBoolInfo
  let map1 := map1.insert `System.Platform.isEmscripten platformInfo
  let consts := { originalEnv.constants with map₁ := map1 }
  let oldKenv := originalEnv.toKernelEnv
  let replacedKenv := kernelMk consts oldKenv.quotInit oldKenv.diagnostics
    oldKenv.const2ModIdx (getExtensions oldKenv) #[] originalEnv.header
  modifyEnv fun env => (setChecked env replacedKenv).setExporting false

  let falseE := mkConst ``Bool.false
  let trueE := mkConst ``Bool.true
  let platformE := mkConst `System.Platform.isEmscripten
  let hred := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) boolTy falseE
  let hev := mkApp3 (mkConst `Lean.ofReduceBool) platformE falseE hred
  let ht := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) boolTy trueE
  let htSymm := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.symm [1]) #[boolTy, platformE, trueE, ht]
  let hf := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.trans [1])
    #[boolTy, trueE, platformE, falseE, htSymm, hev]
  let boomValue := mkAppN (mkConst ``Bool.noConfusion [0])
    #[mkConst ``False, trueE, falseE, hf]
  addDecl <| .thmDecl {
    name := `boom
    levelParams := []
    type := mkConst ``False
    value := boomValue
    all := [`boom]
  }

  let coreSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Core
  let platformSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.System.Platform
  let patchModule (src : FilePath) (mod : Name)
      (repls : Array ConstantInfo) : IO Unit := do
    let (data, _) ← readModuleData src
    let constants := data.constants.map fun c =>
      match repls.find? (fun r => r.name == c.name) with
      | some r => r
      | none => c
    let root := FilePath.mk ".lake/build/lib/lean"
    let dst := modToFilePath root mod "olean"
    IO.FS.createDirAll dst.parent.get!
    saveModuleData dst mod { data with constants }

  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule coreSrc `Init.Core #[reduceBoolInfo, ofReduceBoolInfo]
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule platformSrc `Init.System.Platform #[platformInfo]

theorem erdos_242 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :
    ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by
  exact False.elim boom
